report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 78ms, zero dependency timeouts, zero db pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This healthy data contradicts the alert hypothesis, so no evidence-supported root-cause candidate can be bounded. Handing off for downstream telemetry and alert-source verification.
missing_evidence: Current telemetry showing elevated checkout error rate or latency (alert contradicts observed 0.1% errors, p95 78ms)
Per-service error/latency breakdown for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis
Dependency timeout and db_pool_waiter metrics for downstream services
Logs/traces from downstream services during the alert window
